headline: ARTEMIS GOLD BUYS VISTA GOLD IN US$427M ALL-STOCK DEAL — 9.1MOZ MT TODD ADDS AUSTRALIA FLAGSHIP AT 29% PREMIUM
snippet: Artemis Gold Inc. has agreed to acquire Vista Gold Corp. in an all-stock deal valued at approximately US$427 million, with Vista shareholders receiving 0.0966 Artemis shares per share — an implied consideration of US$2.83/share, representing a 29% premium to the 20-day VWAP as of September 18. The key asset is Mt Todd in Australia's Northern Territory, a fully permitted, feasibility-stage project hosting 9.1 million ounces of Measured and Indicated resources and 1.4 million ounces Inferred. Artemis, which is prioritizing its Blackwater Phase 1A and EP2 expansion in British Columbia, sees Mt Todd advancing to construction following the completion of EP2, with the combined entity on a pathway to more than one million ounces of annual gold production.

headline: MARATHON MINE FULLY FUNDED AT C$1.3B — GENERATION MINING STARTS CONSTRUCTION ON CANADA'S NEXT COPPER-PALLADIUM MINE THIS QUARTER
snippet: Generation Mining has closed a C$200 million bought deal — the final piece of a C$1.3 billion construction financing package for the Marathon copper-palladium project in northwestern Ontario — with early-works construction beginning in Q4 2026 and a 27-month build timeline. The financing stack includes the Canada Growth Fund (C$140M), the Canada Infrastructure Bank (C$50M), Export Development Canada, equipment financing, and a metals streaming arrangement; the Ontario government also committed a non-binding C$11M through the Critical Minerals Processing Fund. Marathon will produce a concentrate carrying copper, palladium, platinum, gold, and silver from a district that has been permitted and community-consulted for years — making this one of the most advanced critical minerals projects in Canada at the time of construction launch.

headline: DPM METALS DRILLS 1,054M AT 2.49 g/t AuEq AT BREVENE PORPHYRY SOUTH, BULGARIA — TIER 1 SCALE EMERGING BESIDE PRODUCING CHELOPECH MINE
snippet: DPM Metals Inc. (TSX: DPM, ASX: DPM) reported delineation drilling results from Brevene Porphyry South that include EX_BRESPO_03 returning 1,054 metres at 2.49 g/t AuEq (1.20 g/t Au, 1.20% Cu, 43.46 g/t Mo), and EX_BRES_555_02A intersecting 716.6 metres at 3.30 g/t AuEq (1.63 g/t Au, 1.58% Cu), including 138.6 metres at 5.71 g/t AuEq. The discovery is contiguous with the Chelopech copper-gold mine concession in Bulgaria, where DPM has over two decades of operating experience — a structural advantage that materially derisks development. Eight high-capacity rigs are now committed to approximately 15,000 additional metres of drilling through year-end, and preliminary metallurgical testing confirms the mineralization is amenable to conventional flotation producing 10-25% copper concentrates at 12-20 g/t Au.

headline: SOUTHERN SILVER HITS 5.3M OF 850 g/t AgEq AT CERRO LAS MINITAS — 35M BULK INTERVAL AT 399 g/t AgEq IN DURANGO, MEXICO
snippet: Southern Silver Exploration Corp. (TSXV: SSV) released the first five drill holes from its 14,000-metre definition program at the Puro Corazon target within the Cerro Las Minitas silver-lead-zinc project in Durango, Mexico. Highlight intercepts include 5.3 metres at 850 g/t AgEq and 9.4 metres at 665 g/t AgEq in hole 26CLM-227, plus a 35.0-metre bulk interval at 399 g/t AgEq (188 g/t Ag, 4.9% Pb, 4.6% Zn) in 26CLM-225. The program is designed to upgrade resource classification over roughly 200 metres strike by 300 metres down-dip at Puro Corazon, with assays pending from the subsequent holes. At spot silver of US$66-67/oz, the polymetallic credit structure (silver, lead, zinc) significantly improves project economics versus a pure-silver calculation.

headline: GREENLAND MINES MORE THAN DOUBLES SARFARTOQ FOOTPRINT TO 454 km² AS RARE EARTH MAGNET RACE INTENSIFIES BEFORE TRUMP-XI SUMMIT
snippet: Greenland Mines Ltd (Nasdaq: GRML) has submitted an application to the Government of Greenland for a new exploration licence covering approximately 262 km² immediately east of its existing Sarfartoq block, increasing the company's total footprint in the West Greenland rare earth and carbonatite district from 192 km² to approximately 454 km². The expansion almost doubles the ground held over the known rare earth magnet mineral district three days ahead of the September 24 Trump-Xi summit in Washington, where China's rare earth export controls are expected to dominate the critical minerals agenda. Greenland, as a Danish autonomous territory, occupies a strategically unique position in the Western push to build non-Chinese NdPr supply chains for defence and EV applications.

headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,380, SILVER CLIMBS 1.41% AS OIL RETREATS — THURSDAY'S TRUMP-XI SUMMIT IS THE WEEK'S BINARY CATALYST FOR PRECIOUS METALS
snippet: Gold held steady near US$4,380 and silver gained 1.41% to US$66.35 on Monday, September 21, as oil prices retreated amid diplomacy hopes around the weekend Houthi strike on Saudi Arabia — easing inflation fears and pulling Treasury yields lower in a configuration that benefits non-yielding metals. The key setup for the week is Thursday's Trump-Xi summit in Washington: a constructive outcome on rare earths or tariffs would be gold-neutral to mildly negative via dollar strength, while a breakdown on Taiwan or critical minerals could produce an immediate safe-haven spike. Technically, gold needs to clear US$4,420 on expanding volume to confirm fresh institutional buying rather than continued short-covering from the September 15-16 Fed rate hike overhang.

headline: BLUE STAR GOLD COMPLETES PHASE 2 AT AUMA, FIRES FIRST-EVER HOLES AT NEW PENNY LANE TARGET — 6+ g/t Au IN WEST AFRICAN GOLD DISTRICT
snippet: Blue Star Gold Corp. (TSXV: BAU) announced the completion of its 2026 Phase 2 drill program at the Auma project, releasing follow-up results from the Auma Bamako Target and assays from the first-ever holes at the Auma Penny Lane Target. Highlights include 4.3 metres at 6.06 g/t gold from 82.7 metres at Bamako, and 2.7 metres at 6.23 g/t gold from 60.1 metres at Penny Lane — confirming the Penny Lane corridor hosts the same high-grade oxide mineralization that characterizes the Bamako system. With Phase 2 now complete and high-grade intercepts confirmed at both targets within the Phase 1 discovery footprint, Blue Star is positioned to define a maiden resource estimate scope for the Auma district heading into Q4 2026.

headline: CRUDE DIPS AS HOUTHI DIPLOMACY HOPES EASE; BASE METALS GAIN WHILE PRECIOUS METALS CAPPED BY USD INTO TRUMP-XI SUMMIT
snippet: Newsquawk's September 21 market analysis notes that crude futures retreated from weekend highs reached after Houthi missile and drone strikes on Saudi Arabia, as signs of US-Iran diplomatic engagement tempered the initial risk premium. The dollar strengthened on the softer oil print, capping precious metals gains despite the safe-haven backdrop from Middle East tensions. Base metals (copper, aluminium, zinc, nickel) outperformed precious metals on Monday, with copper advancing on continued China physical demand signals ahead of the Trump-Xi summit — a setup where a cooperative outcome on trade and critical minerals would further support industrial metals while a confrontational tone would reverse them sharply and spike gold.

headline: EDC: CANADA RISKS EXPORTING $98B A YEAR IN CRITICAL MINERAL VALUE BY SHIPPING RAW COMMODITIES INSTEAD OF PROCESSED PRODUCTS
snippet: Export Development Canada (EDC) warned that Canada is leaving as much as US$98 billion in annual economic value on the table by exporting raw critical mineral commodities rather than building domestic refining and processing capacity. EDC CEO Alison Nankivell, speaking shortly after Prime Minister Mark Carney's Canada Investment Summit in Toronto, identified rare earths, graphite, lithium, copper, and uranium as the five commodities with the greatest downstream value-add potential. For junior mining investors, the report underlines the policy momentum behind Canadian critical minerals infrastructure spending — the same backdrop that enabled Generation Mining's C$1.3B Marathon financing package to close this week.
